snapshot_date=(SELECT pd FROM pri)) fp FROM snap WHERE page<>'Koocester' GROUP BY country,page), ctot AS (SELECT country, sum(followers) FILTER (WHERE snapshot_date=(SELECT md FROM lat)) f,
